lihir.name: Lihir
driver_notes: Access to higher grade ore after September maintenance supports Q4 output. El Niño water availability can affect production and unit costs.
Management identified higher grade ore from mine optimization as a 2027 growth driver.

cadia.name: Cadia
driver_notes: April seismic disruption affected the nine-month base. The company reported a recovery to pre-event levels in Q3.
PC2-3 final drawbell fired in September. PC1-2 cave establishment resumed after regulatory approvals. Annual output from the next cave remains sensitive to development and sequencing.

tanami.name: Tanami
driver_notes: Higher grade stopes support Q4 output.
Shaft construction for Expansion 2 was complete in Q3. Management expected commercial production toward the end of the first half of 2027.

boddington.name: Boddington
driver_notes: Mine sequence and grade drive gold and copper output. The waste stripping campaign was expected to conclude by end-2026.
Management identified access to higher grade ore as a 2027 growth driver.

ahafo_south.name: Ahafo South
driver_notes: The Subika open pit finished in 2025. Lower ore grade drove the decline in year-to-date production.

ahafo_north.name: Ahafo North
driver_notes: Commercial production began in October 2025. The FY2025 production figure includes 21koz of development ounces.
Q4 production was expected to increase with ramp-up and access to higher grade ore.

merian.name: Merian
driver_notes: Newmont consolidates 100% of this variable-interest entity. The government's 25% interest reduces attributable output. The Q3 deduction uses the rounded filed 17koz.

cerro_negro.name: Cerro Negro
driver_notes: The October outlook expected higher Q4 production from productivity improvements and mining the Vein Zone open pit.

yanacocha.name: Yanacocha
driver_notes: Leach pad production depends on placement volumes and leach grade. Newmont expected extended mining to continue providing low-cost ounces in 2027.

penasquito.name: Peñasquito
driver_notes: Ore sequencing and grade affect each metal differently. Newmont expects Q4 silver production to be approximately half of Q3 and lower silver, lead and zinc output in 2027.
Newmont reports standalone silver, lead and zinc co-product sales at Peñasquito. Smaller by-product credits on other operating lines are outside these physical quantities.

red_chris.name: Red Chris
driver_notes: Published quantities and operating results already reflect Newmont's 70% interest.
The potential underground block cave remained subject to a full-funds decision expected in early 2027. Its production is outside these anchors.

brucejack.name: Brucejack
driver_notes: Grade, throughput and inventory timing affect quarterly sales. 2026 Q3 production exceeded sales by 13koz.

ngm.name: Nevada Gold Mines
driver_notes: Barrick operates the JV. Published Newmont quantities and results already reflect its 38.5% interest.

The amended JV agreement contemplates Fourmile, Fiberline and Mike development property contributions. They provide no production in these anchors. The $1.95 billion payment is a separate transaction cash flow.

pueblo_viejo.name: Pueblo Viejo
driver_notes: Newmont reports its 40% attributable production in the portfolio KPI. It recognizes affiliate earnings under the equity method.
Purchases of its share at market price, net of subsequent resales, are immaterial and included in Other income (loss), net. They are outside consolidated mining sales and CAS.

fruta_del_norte.name: Fruta del Norte
driver_notes: Lundin Gold wholly owns and operates the mine. Newmont's 32% holding is accounted for using the equity method and a quarter lag.

notes: October 22 guidance affirmed company-wide production. Mine figures are the original February 19 guidance. Their residual versus YTD is an allocation proxy for Q4, not refreshed site-level guidance.
The October AISC reconciliation gives the FY2026 consolidated gold sales volume of 4,900koz. Sales exclude equity-method investees and include 100% of Merian.
Full-year 5,260koz less 3,896koz YTD implies 1,364koz Q4. The separately published 1,365koz quarterly outlook is rounded.
The issuer expects Peñasquito Q4 silver output at approximately half Q3. The 5Moz full-year guidance residual uses published whole-Moz quantities.

ngm_operator_outlook.note: Use the midpoint of the operator's illustrative range and apply Newmont's 38.5% interest once. The remaining portfolio growth is allocated to the three managed growth mines.

analyst_assumptions.note: Use 4% attributable gold growth as a point estimate within management's low-to-mid single-digit description. After the Nevada Gold Mines operator midpoint, allocate the remaining incremental ounces to Lihir, Boddington and Tanami by their 2026 production weights. Model a 10% reduction in each Peñasquito co-product as an editable proxy for the disclosed lower direction. These percentages and managed mine estimates are analyst assumptions.

notes: The company identifies higher grade ore at Lihir and Boddington, commercial operation of the Tanami expansion, and extension of mining at Yanacocha.
The company expects lower silver, lead and zinc production at Peñasquito. It provides no 2027 site-level volume or shipment figures in the October update.
Use mine life, grade and recovery schedules before extending these short-term operating assumptions into a long-dated NAV or terminal production profile.

technical_report_context.basis: Reference values from February reserve-case technical plans. Their price assumptions, timing and recovery definitions differ from the operating forecast. Cadia's plan predates the April seismic event.

notes: These market-price purchases, net of subsequent third-party sales, are included in Other income (loss), net, and the net result is immaterial.
Pueblo Viejo and Lundin Gold volumes contribute to attributable gold production. Their results are excluded from consolidated mining revenue and Costs applicable to sales.
Gold quantity basis is consolidated, including 100% of Merian and Newmont's already proportionate share of NGM and Red Chris. Equity-method sites have null consolidated production and sales.
No gold-equivalent quantities enter the metal revenue forecast. Reported copper, silver, lead and zinc are on separate physical units, with site totals rounded as filed.
Attributable gold sales exclude Pueblo Viejo and Fruta del Norte. Rounded attributable production site values are retained as filed or derived with the filed Merian minority deduction.
The 2025 reported basis includes 209koz produced and 213koz sold by mines divested in 2025. Exclude those sites from the 2026 and 2027 forecast base.
